name: IR-15 Mobile Security Platform
description: The IR-15 Mobile Security Platform was a model of six-legged battle droid used by the the Shroud, a freelance spy active during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The Shroud's lieutenant Stangg employed IR-15 droids among the forces that defended the Shroud's base on the planet Quesh.
